name: カメラモデル識別
description: 識別します the source camera model through sensor ノイズパターンs and processing pipeline fingerprints.
algorithm: Sensor-Based Camera Source Identification via Processing Pipeline Analysis
mechanism: Each camera model has a unique processing pipeline including CFA interpolation, white balancing, color correction, and JPEG圧縮. This method extracts 特徴 from these processing steps を識別するために the source camera.
parameters: Features: color processing, CFA interpolation, JPEG tables, Classifier: SVM/RF, Training: per-model
source: Lukas, J. et al. (2006) — Digital Camera Identification from Sensor Pattern Noise, IEEE TIFS
useCase: 申告されたソースカメラの検証と未知またはAI出力の画像検出

references.title: Lukas, J. et al. (2006) — Digital Camera Identification from Sensor Pattern Noise, IEEE TIFS

strengths:
• High 精度 camera identification
• Based on physical sensor properties
• Difficult to spoof
• Works にわたる camera brands
limitations:
• Requires reference images from known cameras
• Performance varies by camera model
• Social media compression reduces 精度
• Cannot identify specific camera instance
